cancerCompanion.title: Cancer Companion Service
cancerCompanion.description: A patient-centred, full-journey support model. Our multidisciplinary team accompanies you from diagnosis through to recovery.
cancerCompanion.pageDesc: A patient-centred, full-journey oncology support service. Our multidisciplinary team provides continuous support from diagnosis through treatment to recovery, including care navigation, treatment management, and decision support.
cancerCompanion.heroSubtitle: Our Cancer Companion Service is a comprehensive, person-centred oncology support programme. A multidisciplinary team — including case managers, clinical research specialists, and nutritionists — works together to provide continuous support for patients and their families from diagnosis through treatment to recovery. The service covers the entire disease journey, enabling seamless transitions from pre-hospital to post-hospital care, and from hospital to home.

pillars.title: Care Navigation
pillars.desc: Assistance with specialist appointments, medical record organisation, appointment accompaniment, and doctor's order documentation to ensure efficient care.

pillars.title: Treatment & Recovery Management
pillars.desc: Personalised treatment tracking plans, side effect management, medication reminders, nutrition and exercise guidance throughout your treatment journey.

pillars.title: Information & Decision Support
pillars.desc: Interpretation of medical reports and treatment options, clinical trial matching information, and support for informed decision-making at key milestones.

cancerCompanion.teamSubtitle: Each team member plays a specialised role, working together to ensure comprehensive support throughout your cancer journey

teamMembers.title: Clinical Research Specialist
teamMembers.desc: Continuously tracking the latest global clinical trials and treatment options to match you with the most suitable research opportunities.

teamMembers.title: Nutritionist
teamMembers.desc: Providing science-based dietary recommendations and nutritional supplementation plans tailored to your treatment stage and personal needs.

cancerCompanion.journeySubtitle: We stand by your side at every critical stage, from diagnosis through long-term follow-up

journeyStages.title: Diagnosis Phase
journeyStages.desc: Organising diagnostic reports, arranging second opinions, and establishing personalised treatment baselines

journeyStages.title: Treatment Phase
journeyStages.desc: Tracking treatment progress, managing side effects, and coordinating multidisciplinary consultations

journeyStages.title: Recovery Phase
journeyStages.desc: Developing rehabilitation plans, providing nutrition and exercise guidance, and scheduling regular follow-ups

journeyStages.title: Recurrence Management
journeyStages.desc: Establishing long-term monitoring protocols for early detection of recurrence and rapid response activation

cancerCompanion.suitabilityHeading: Is the Cancer Companion Service Right for You?
cancerCompanion.suitabilitySubtitle: If you are experiencing any of the following, our Cancer Companion Service is here for you
suitabilityItems: Recently diagnosed with cancer and feeling overwhelmed — need professional treatment pathway guidance
Facing multiple treatment options and struggling to decide — want objective information and decision support
Currently undergoing treatment and need help managing side effects, medication schedules, and nutrition
Entering the recovery phase and seeking continuous, science-based management and follow-up
Concerned about cancer recurrence risk and need a systematic, long-term monitoring and prevention plan
As a family caregiver, want to provide the best support but feel exhausted and overwhelmed
Experiencing significant psychological stress during the cancer journey and need emotional support and professional companionship

geneticTesting.title: Tumour Genetic Testing
geneticTesting.description: Providing hereditary risk assessment and precision genetic testing consultation for patients and their families.
geneticTesting.pageDesc: Hereditary risk assessment and precision genetic testing consultation for patients and families. Understand your genes to protect your family's future health.
geneticTesting.heroSubtitle: Providing hereditary risk assessment and precision genetic testing consultation. Understand your genes to protect your family's future health.
geneticTesting.coreValueHeading: Understanding Your Genes Is the Warmest Gift to Your Family
geneticTesting.coreValueDesc: Tumour genetic testing is not only for patients. Since first-degree relatives share similar genetic backgrounds, family members may also be potential carriers of disease-causing genes. Through genetic testing, we can help you and your family understand risks early and develop prevention strategies.
geneticTesting.whoHeading: Who Should Consider Tumour Genetic Testing?

whoItems.title: Family Members of Cancer Patients
whoItems.desc: First-degree relatives of someone diagnosed with cancer who want to understand their own genetic risk

whoItems.title: Young-Onset Cancer Patients
whoItems.desc: Diagnosed with cancer before age 50 — may indicate an underlying hereditary cancer syndrome

whoItems.title: Multiple Primary Tumour Patients
whoItems.desc: Multiple primary tumours in the same individual, possibly linked to genetic mutations

whoItems.title: Rare Cancer Patients
whoItems.desc: Diagnosed with rare or unusual tumour types — seeking targeted therapy options based on genetic profiling

processSteps.title: Easy Sample Collection
processSteps.desc: Just a small blood draw or saliva sample — no hospitalisation or special preparation needed

processSteps.title: Professional Testing
processSteps.desc: Samples are sent to certified laboratories for comprehensive genetic analysis using next-generation sequencing

processSteps.title: Report Interpretation
processSteps.desc: A genetic counsellor provides one-on-one report interpretation and personalised risk management recommendations

Medical Report Analysis: Preliminary analysis and recommendations from our medical advisory team
Cancer Companion Service: Patient-centred, full-journey support with a multidisciplinary team from diagnosis to recovery
Genetic Testing Consultation: Information and guidance on tumour genetic testing

privacy.pageDesc: Cancer Link's Privacy Policy, explaining how we collect, use, and protect your personal data.
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Cancer Link ('we', 'us', 'our') places great importance on your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect your personal data. Please read this policy carefully before using our services.

collection.title: 1. Data We Collect
collection.intro: We may collect your personal data through the following means:
items: Information you directly provide through registration forms or consultation applications when using our website or services
Information you provide when communicating with us via WhatsApp, email, or other channels
Information automatically collected through browser cookies and similar tracking technologies
Medical information you authorise us to obtain from third parties (such as hospitals or testing institutions)
collection.dataTypesTitle: Types of personal data we may collect include:
dataTypes: Basic personal information: name, phone number, email address
Health and medical information: medical history, diagnostic reports, treatment records, genetic testing results
Technical data: IP address, browser type, operating system, access times and page views

usage.title: 2. How We Use Your Data
usage.intro: We may use the data we collect for the following purposes:
items: Providing clinical trial matching services based on your medical information
Arranging cancer companion services and specialist consultations
Responding to your inquiries, requests, and complaints
Improving our service quality and website user experience
Complying with legal, regulatory, and lawful government requests

sharing.title: 3. Data Disclosure & Sharing
sharing.intro: We do not sell your personal data. We may disclose your data in the following circumstances:
items: With your explicit consent, to relevant clinical research institutions, partner hospitals, or laboratories
To third-party service providers (such as web hosting, data analytics) who are bound by strict confidentiality obligations
When required by law, to regulatory authorities, law enforcement, or courts
In the event of corporate restructuring, merger, or sale, to relevant parties, while ensuring your data continues to be protected

security.title: 4. Data Security
security.intro: We implement reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data, including:
items: SSL/TLS encryption for data transmission
Restricted access to personal data — only authorised personnel may access
Regular review and updating of our security measures
Staff confidentiality training and agreements
security.disclaimer: However, please note that no method of internet transmission or electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to protect your personal data, we cannot guarantee its absolute security.

retention.title: 5. Data Retention
retention.content: We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was collected. The specific retention period depends on the nature of the data, the purpose of collection, and legal requirements. When no longer needed, we will securely delete or anonymise your data.

rights.title: 6. Your Rights
rights.intro: Under applicable law, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
items: Right of Access: Request access to personal data we hold about you
Right of Rectification: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal data
Right of Erasure: Request deletion of your personal data under certain circumstances
Right to Restrict Processing: Request restriction of processing under certain circumstances
Right to Data Portability: Request your data in a structured format or its transfer to a third party
Right to Object: Object to our processing of your personal data based on legitimate interests

cookies.title: 7. Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: Our website uses cookies and similar technologies to improve your browsing experience. Cookies are small text files stored on your device.

types.essential: Essential Cookies: Ensure core website functionality such as page navigation and secure area access. These cookies do not collect personal information.
types.analytics: Analytics Cookies: Help us understand how visitors interact with the website, collecting and reporting anonymous information to improve the website experience.
types.preferences: Preference Cookies: Remember your language preferences and other settings to provide a more personalised browsing experience.
types.control: You can manage or delete cookies through your browser settings. However, please note that disabling certain cookies may affect website functionality.

children.title: 8. Children's Privacy
children.content: Our services are not directed at individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal data from minors. If we discover we have inadvertently collected data from a minor, we will delete it immediately. If you are a parent or guardian and discover your child has provided us with personal data, please contact us.

thirdParty.title: 9. Third-Party Links
thirdParty.content: This website may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of these third-party sites. We recommend reviewing the privacy policies of any third-party sites you visit.

updates.title: 10. Policy Updates
updates.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Updated versions will be posted on this page with the revision date noted. For significant changes, we will notify you through website announcements or email.

questions.q: What is the clinical trial matching service?
questions.a: Our clinical trial matching service helps cancer patients find suitable clinical trials. Our expert team analyses your medical reports in detail, screening global clinical trials to find the best matches for your condition, and assists you in contacting research institutions.

questions.q: Who is the Cancer Companion Service for?
questions.a: The Cancer Companion Service is suitable for newly diagnosed patients feeling uncertain about treatment direction, patients undergoing treatment who need professional management support, patients entering recovery who want continued monitoring, and family caregivers who feel overwhelmed. Whatever stage of the cancer journey you are in, our companion service provides targeted support.

questions.q: Do patients need to pay for clinical trial treatment costs?
questions.a: In most cases, once a patient is successfully enrolled, trial-related treatment costs specified in the research protocol are covered by the trial sponsor. Specific cost arrangements are detailed in the informed consent form. Our team will help you understand the cost arrangements.

questions.q: Who should consider tumour genetic testing?
questions.a: Tumour genetic testing is suitable for both cancer patients and their family members. Testing is recommended in the following situations: multiple cancer cases in the family, cancer diagnosis at a young age, multiple or rare primary tumours, or for patients planning targeted therapy.

questions.q: How do I start using Cancer Link's services?
questions.a: You can connect with our team instantly via WhatsApp, or fill out the application form on any service page. We will arrange for a specialist to contact you within 24–48 hours to understand your situation and provide personalised recommendations. The entire initial consultation process is completely free.

questions.q: How is my privacy protected during the service?
questions.a: We strictly comply with Hong Kong's Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance. All medical information is encrypted during transmission and storage, and shared only with necessary healthcare professionals within the scope of your authorisation. We will never disclose your personal data to third parties without your explicit consent.
